(*) 3.1. Capstone Project name:
English: FinViet – AI-Powered Personal Finance Tracker and Spending Advisor for Vietnamese Gen Z
Vietnamese: FinViet – Ứng Dụng Theo Dõi Tài Chính Cá Nhân Thông Minh và Tư Vấn Chi Tiêu Bằng AI cho Giới Trẻ Việt Nam
a. Context:

Vietnam's Gen Z population — broadly defined as those born between 1997 and 2012 — now comprises over 22 million people, many of whom are university students and young professionals managing independent finances for the first time. This demographic transacts almost entirely through digital wallets and mobile banking: MoMo, ZaloPay, VietinBank iPay, BIDV SmartBanking, and Vietcombank digibank are among the most commonly used platforms. Despite frequent digital transactions, the vast majority of young Vietnamese have no systematic way to understand their own spending patterns.

The core problem is that Vietnamese transaction data is inherently messy and unstructured. Bank SMS notifications and e-wallet push alerts contain terse, abbreviation-heavy Vietnamese descriptions such as 'An sang Q2 voi bn', 'Grab 4.7km', 'Nap Lien Quan 50k', or 'Chuyen khoan hoc phi HK2' — strings that no existing rule-based categorization engine can reliably parse. Users who want to track spending must manually label every transaction, which is tedious enough that virtually no one sustains the habit beyond a few days.

FinViet addresses this problem by combining manual transaction entry and CSV/SMS import with an LLM-based categorization engine trained to understand Vietnamese transaction language. The result is an effortless spending tracker where categories are assigned automatically, weekly AI-generated financial summaries explain spending behavior in plain Vietnamese, and a conversational finance advisor answers questions like 'Did I spend more on food this month than last month?' or 'How much can I save if I cut back on coffee?' — making financial self-awareness accessible and engaging for everyday Vietnamese students and young workers.
Functional requirement :
Mobile Application — Student/User (Flutter)
Register and log in using email/password or Google OAuth; set up personal profile and monthly income estimate
Wallet management: create multiple wallets (Cash, MoMo, Bank Account) with individual balances; transfer between wallets
Transaction entry:
Manual entry:
amount, description, date, wallet — AI auto-suggests category based on description
SMS-paste import:
user pastes a bank SMS notification text; system extracts amount, merchant, and date automatically
Photo Import:
Scan photo of transaction bill
Spending Dashboard:
monthly overview chart (donut by category), daily spending bar chart, top 5 merchants by spend, week-over-week comparison
AI-Analysis
AI Spending Score ('Cham Diem Vi'):
weekly score from 0–100 evaluating budget adherence, savings consistency, and unusual spending spikes — displayed as a colored badge with a one-paragraph AI commentary in Vietnamese
Weekly AI Financial Report:
auto-generated every Monday morning; 150–200 word Vietnamese narrative summarizing last week's spending, flagging overspent categories, and suggesting one specific saving action
Finance Advisor Chatbot:

in-app chat interface where users ask questions in Vietnamese about their own data; LLM retrieves relevant transaction summaries from the backend and answers contextually (e.g., 'Tháng này tôi tiêu bao nhiêu cho cafe?', 'So với tháng trước tôi có tiết kiệm hơn không?')
Wallet Management
Budget management:
set monthly spending limits per category; real-time progress bars showing budget consumption; push notification alert when 80% of any category budget is reached
Savings Goal tracker:
create named saving goals (e.g., 'Mua laptop', 'Du lich Da Lat') with target amount and deadline; auto-calculate required monthly contribution; track progress
Notification center:
push reminders for budget alerts, weekly report availability, and savings goal milestones
Admin Dashboard (Web — ReactJS)
User account management: view registered users, activate/deactivate accounts, reset passwords
System analytics: total users, daily active users, total transactions logged, AI API call volume and estimated cost per day
Category correction log: view cases where users manually overrode AI-suggested categories — useful for identifying prompt improvement opportunities
Announcement broadcast: send in-app notifications to all users or targeted segments
Non-functional requirement:
Performance: AI categorization response < 3 seconds per transaction; app cold start < 4 seconds on mid-range Android device
Scalability: backend supports 2,000 concurrent users; AI API calls managed via async queue to avoid rate-limit blocking

Security: all financial data encrypted at rest (AES-256); HTTPS enforced; JWT with refresh token rotation; no raw transaction data sent to third parties beyond OpenAI API (descriptions only, no account numbers)
Compatibility: Flutter app targets iOS 13+ and Android 8.0+ (API level 26); Admin web supports Chrome 100+, Firefox 100+, Safari 15+
Reliability: 99% backend uptime; if AI categorization service is unavailable, transaction is saved with category 'Uncategorized' and re-processed automatically when service recovers

Privacy: user transaction descriptions are sent to OpenAI API for categorization — users are informed via privacy notice at onboarding; no personally identifiable financial account numbers are transmitted
(*) 3.2. Main proposal content (including result and product)
Proposed Solutions:
Build a cross-platform mobile application (Flutter) as the primary user interface for transaction logging, budget management, and AI financial insights
Develop a RESTful backend (Spring Boot) with a PostgreSQL database managing user accounts, wallets, transaction records, budget rules, and AI analysis history

Implement an AI categorization engine using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini via API: each transaction description is passed to the LLM with a Vietnamese-aware prompt that maps free-text to predefined spending categories (Food, Transport, Entertainment, Education, Health, Shopping, Bills, Savings)

Deliver a weekly AI Financial Report — a 150–200 word plain-Vietnamese narrative generated by GPT-4o summarizing the user's spending behavior, identifying unusual patterns, and offering one actionable saving tip
Provide a conversational Finance Advisor chatbot (in-app) allowing users to ask ad-hoc questions about their own transaction history in natural Vietnamese language
Build a web-based Admin Dashboard (ReactJS) for platform monitoring, user management, and system analytics
Applied Theory:

The team applies iterative agile development with UML 2.0 system modeling across all four members. Documentation deliverables include: User Requirements Specification, Software Requirements Specification, System Architecture Design, Database Schema (ERD), AI Prompt Engineering Specification, API Documentation, Testing Strategy and Results (unit, integration, user acceptance), Deployment Guide, and User Manual.
Backend Framework: Spring Boot (Java) — RESTful API, Spring Security for JWT auth, Spring Data JPA for database access
Database: PostgreSQL — tables for users, wallets, transactions, categories, budgets, saving goals, AI report history

AI Integration: OpenAI API — GPT-4o-mini for transaction categorization and Spending Score commentary (cost-efficient); GPT-4o for Weekly Financial Report and Finance Advisor chatbot (higher quality output)
Async Processing: Spring Async + Redis for queuing batch CSV categorization jobs and weekly report generation
Push Notifications: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for mobile push alerts
Email: SendGrid for account verification and weekly report email digest (optional)
Cloud: Railway or Render for student-phase deployment; GCP Cloud Run or AWS EC2 for production
Mobile: Flutter (Dart) — single codebase for iOS and Android; Riverpod for state management; fl_chart for spending visualization charts; SQLite (drift) for offline transaction cache
Web Admin: ReactJS + Vite; Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui; Recharts for system analytics charts; React Query for data fetching
Products (Expected Deliverables):

FinViet Mobile App (iOS & Android): Full-featured personal finance tracker with AI categorization, budget alerts, spending dashboard, weekly AI report, Finance Advisor chatbot, and savings goal tracker
Spring Boot Backend API: RESTful server managing all user data, transaction processing, AI orchestration, and notification delivery

AI Engine Module: Prompt-engineered OpenAI API integration for Vietnamese transaction categorization, Spending Score generation, weekly narrative reports, and conversational Q&A over user financial data
Admin Web Dashboard: ReactJS interface for user management, system monitoring, and API cost tracking
Technical Documentation: Architecture diagrams, prompt engineering specification, API docs, database schema, user manuals, deployment guides
Proposed Tasks:

Package 1 (Week 1–2): Foundation — Spring Boot project scaffolding, PostgreSQL schema design (users, wallets, transactions, categories, budgets, goals), JWT authentication with Google OAuth, Firebase project setup for FCM, CI/CD with GitHub Actions

Package 2 (Week 3–4): Core Transaction Features — wallet CRUD, manual transaction entry API, CSV parser for VietinBank/BIDV/Vietcombank export formats, SMS-paste text extraction; Flutter screens: Home dashboard, Add Transaction, Wallet list

Package 3 (Week 5–6): AI Categorization Engine — OpenAI GPT-4o-mini integration with Vietnamese-aware prompt template; batch categorization for CSV import via async queue; category override feedback loop; Flutter category selection UI with AI suggestion badge

Package 4 (Week 7–8): Budget & Spending Analytics — budget rule CRUD, real-time budget consumption tracking, push notification triggers at 80%/100% budget thresholds; Flutter spending dashboard (donut chart, bar chart, top merchants); week-over-week comparison

Package 5 (Week 9–10): AI Weekly Report & Finance Advisor — scheduled weekly report generation (Spring Scheduler + GPT-4o); Spending Score algorithm and AI commentary; Finance Advisor chatbot backend (context-aware prompt with user transaction summary); Flutter chatbot UI and report viewer

Package 6 (Week 11–12): Savings Goals & Admin Dashboard — saving goal CRUD with progress calculation; milestone push notifications; ReactJS Admin Panel (user management, API cost dashboard, category correction log); integration testing across all modules

Package 7 (Week 13–14): Beta Testing & Deployment — recruit 20+ Gen Z beta testers from university network; collect feedback on AI categorization accuracy, UX flow, and report quality; bug fixes and prompt refinement; production deployment; complete documentation bundle and final presentation
